title: Humanize Olympiad Agents: A Multi-Session Workflow for Olympiad Problem Solving with Solve, Review, Wiki, Verify
title_zh: 人性化奥林匹克智能体：一种用于奥林匹克竞赛问题求解的多会话工作流（包含求解、评审、维基与验证）

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly improving on long-horizon scientific and olympiad tasks. Recent systems have produced a Lean-formalized resolution of the Navier–Stokes problem and autonomous solutions to four open questions in the Erdős Conjectures database ( OpenAI, 2026b ; Feng et al., 2026 ) . Yet neither system releases both its underlying model and complete inference stack. More broadly, a single agent session remains brittle on difficult problems: an early error can propagate, missing domain knowledge can stall progress, and the agent can appear to succeed after misreading or weakening the task. We introduce HOA (Humanize Olympiads Agent) , an open, flow-level framework that coordinates multiple agent sessions through three complementary feedback channels. First, an independent reviewer checks each candidate and returns actionable feedback. Second, a structured wiki supplies task-specific knowledge that may be missing or unreliable in model pretraining. Third, a verifier checks generated Lean proofs against trusted challenge statements. With GPT-5.6 Sol, HOA reaches the perfect score on IMO, IPhO, and IOI 2026 , and near-full score on IChO 2026 problem set and solves all 672 problems (100%) on PutnamBench . On the Lean-Eval leaderboard, HOA ranks #1 with 251 of 304 problems solved (82.6%) ( Lean Prover Community, 2026 ) . Furthremore, we extend HOA’s results with the open models – With Kimi-K3, HOA also achieves full score on IMO, IPhO,on IOI, and gold-level 97.1% on IChO, which closely matches the closed-source GPT-5.6 Sol + /Goal baseline on IMO and IPhO and exceeds it on IChO and IOI, showing that systematic feedback can compensate for substantial differences in base-model capability.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在长期科学任务和奥林匹克竞赛任务上的表现正在迅速提升。 近期的系统已经实现了纳维-斯托克斯问题的 Lean 形式化求解，并自主解决了 Erdős 猜想数据库中的四个开放问题（OpenAI, 2026b；Feng 等, 2026）。 然而，这两个系统均未同时公开其底层模型和完整的推理栈。 更广泛地说，单个智能体会话在处理难题时仍然脆弱：早期错误可能持续蔓延，领域知识的缺失可能导致进展停滞，而智能体也可能因误解或弱化任务而看似成功。 我们提出了 HOA（Humanize Olympiads Agent），一个开放式的流程级框架，通过三个互补的反馈通道协调多个智能体会话。 首先，一名独立评审员会检查每个候选方案并提供可操作的反馈。 其次，一个结构化维基提供任务特定的知识，这些知识可能在模型预训练阶段缺失或不可靠。 第三，一个验证器会将生成的 Lean 证明与可信的挑战题陈述进行比对。 使用 GPT-5.6 Sol，HOA 在 IMO、IPhO 和 IOI 2026 中获得了满分，并在 IChO 2026 题目集中接近满分，同时解决了 PutnamBench 上的全部 672 道题目（100%）。 在 Lean-Eval 排行榜上，HOA 以 304 道题中正确解答 251 道（82.6%）的成绩位列第一（Lean Prover Community, 2026）。 此外，我们还通过开放模型扩展了 HOA 的成果——使用 Kimi-K3，HOA 同样在 IMO、IPhO 和 IOI 中获得了满分，并在 IChO 中达到了黄金级别的 97.1%；这一成绩与闭源模型 GPT-5.6 Sol + /Goal 在 IMO 和 IPhO 上的基线表现接近，但在 IChO 和 IOI 上更胜一筹，表明系统化的反馈可以弥补基础模型能力之间的显著差异。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based agents can now carry out long sequences of reasoning and action. They browse and synthesize evidence, develop and test code, construct mathematical arguments, and interact with formal proof assistants. Systems such as Deep Research, the AI Scientist, and AI co-scientist show how tools and iterative orchestration can turn a language model into a research workflow rather than a single-response generator ( OpenAI, 2025 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Gottweis et al., 2026 ) . Their performance depends on both the base model and the harness : the prompts, tools, context management, execution environment, and control flow that allocate the inference budget, but all these works do not reveal those details. Community thereby needs open harnesses for those reproducible results.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体现在能够执行长序列的推理和行动。 它们可以浏览和综合证据、编写和测试代码、构建数学论证，并与形式化证明助手进行交互。 诸如“深度研究”（Deep Research）、“人工智能科学家”（AI Scientist）和“人工智能协同科学家”（AI co-scientist）等系统表明，通过工具使用和迭代协调，语言模型可以转变为研究工作流程，而不仅仅是单一响应的生成器（OpenAI, 2025；Lu et al., 2024；Gottweis et al., 2026）。 它们的性能既取决于基础模型，也取决于“执行框架”：即提示词、工具、上下文管理、执行环境和控制流等用于分配推理预算的组件，但这些研究均未揭示这些细节。 因此，学术界需要开放的执行框架来实现这些可复现的结果。

paragraphs.en: Yet most evaluations treat a single agent session as the basic unit of problem solving. This design can be easily integrated into the next generation model and is fragile for hard research-level problems. First, a plausible but false intermediate claim can contaminate the rest of a long trajectory. Second, more reasoning cannot supply a theorem, scientific rule, or algorithmic pattern that the model does not know. Third, an agent may misread a requirement or weaken a goal—for example, by proving a nearby statement or testing convenient cases—and appear to succeed without solving the original task. We refer to this last failure mode as problem misunderstanding and reward hacking. These failures make longer single trajectories yield sharply diminishing returns.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，大多数评估都将单个智能体会话视为问题解决的基本单位。 这种设计可以轻松地集成到下一代模型中，但在处理具有挑战性的研究级问题时却显得脆弱。 首先，一个看似合理但错误的中间结论可能会污染整个长轨迹的后续部分。 其次，更多的推理也无法提供模型本身并不知晓的定理、科学规则或算法模式。 第三，智能体可能会误解某个要求或弱化某个目标——例如，通过证明一个相关的命题或测试一些简单的案例——从而看似成功，却并未真正解决原始任务。 我们将最后这种失败模式称为“问题误解”和“奖励操纵”。 这些失败导致较长的单条轨迹的回报急剧递减。

paragraphs.en: We distinguish three levels of agents. At the model level , a direct API call returns an answer without an execution environment. At the tool level , a CLI-harness such as Codex and Claude Code gives the model tools to read files, execute code, and check intermediate results. At the flow level , a workflow coordinates multiple agent sessions and tools. Humanize is a flow-level protocol that extends Codex with an independent reviewer and a worker–reviewer revision loop ( Liu et al., 2026b ) . The reviewer helps detect hallucinations, problem misunderstanding, and reward hacking.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将智能体分为三个层级。 在模型层级，直接调用 API 会返回一个答案，但没有执行环境。 在工具层级，像 Codex 和 Claude Code 这样的命令行接口封装工具为模型提供了读取文件、执行代码和检查中间结果的工具。 在工作流层级，一个工作流可以协调多个智能体会话和工具。 Humanize 是一种工作流层级的协议，它通过引入独立的评审员以及工人-评审员的修订循环来扩展 Codex（Liu et al., 2026b）。 评审员有助于检测幻觉、问题误解和奖励操纵。

paragraphs.en: We propose HOA (Humanize Olympiads Agent) , whose new contribution is an artifact-centered acceptance protocol that routes structured knowledge retrieval, independent semantic review, and task-specific objective verification through a shared worker–reviewer repair loop and accepts a candidate only after all applicable gates pass. A worker constructs a candidate artifact and consults a structured wiki when it identifies a knowledge gap. An independent reviewer checks the frozen artifact against the original problem and acceptance plan, then returns specific findings to the worker. Semantic review and objective validation remain separate gates. For mathematical tasks, the reviewer runs verifier on the unchanged candidate before accepting it ( Lean FRO, 2026 ) . A result is accepted when every required gate passes. Figure 1 and Figure. 2 explains how HOA solves a complex olympiad question.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 HOA（Humanize Olympiads Agent），其创新之处在于一种以成果为中心的接受协议：该协议将结构化知识检索、独立语义审查和任务特定的目标验证通过共享的“执行者–审查者”修复循环进行流转，并且只有在所有适用关卡均通过后才会接受候选成果。 当执行者发现知识缺口时，会构建一个候选成果并查阅结构化维基。 独立审查者会将已固化的成果与原始问题及接受计划进行比对，然后将具体发现反馈给执行者。 语义审查和目标验证仍作为独立的关卡存在。 对于数学任务，审查者在接受候选成果前，会对其运行验证器（Lean FRO, 2026）。 当所有必要关卡均通过时，该成果即被接受。 图 1 和图 2 说明了 HOA 如何解答一道复杂的奥林匹克竞赛题。

paragraphs.en: The three feedback channels address different failure modes. Review catches omitted cases, invalid inferences, and solutions to the wrong problem. The wiki supplies missing knowledge. Verification provides an objective, task-specific signal. HOA keeps these roles separate while applying all feedback to the same evolving artifact. We evaluate HOA on high-school olympiads, college-level competition mathematics, and research-level formal mathematics, and HOA achieves top performance in various competitions and benchmarks. On the Lean-Eval leaderboard, HOA ranks #1 with 251/304 solves (82.6%) ( Lean Prover Community, 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: We introduce a flow-level worker–review framework for olympiads and frontier problems solving. We add task-specific verification tools, together with a structured wiki that supplies targeted, provenance-tracked knowledge, and thoroughly evaluate across various domains.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为奥林匹克竞赛和前沿问题求解引入了一种流程级的智能体–审查框架。 我们加入了任务特定的验证工具，以及一个提供目标明确、来源可追溯知识的结构化维基，并在多个领域进行了全面评估。

sents.en: We add task-specific verification tools, together with a structured wiki that supplies targeted, provenance-tracked knowledge, and thoroughly evaluate across various domains.

paragraphs.en: We introduce a flow-level formalization agents that can turn physics problems and figures into typed Lean statements, checks them against the original problems, to enable later agent-driven proof.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种流程层面的智能体形式化方法，该方法能够将物理问题和图形转换为带类型的 Lean 语句，并与原始问题进行验证，从而为后续的智能体驱动证明提供支持。

paragraphs.en: HOA reaches state-of-the-art results: full scores on IMO, IPhO, IOI 2026 , and near pefect score on IChO 2026 , all based on the latest competitions and there is no leakage. paragraphs.en: Tool-using agents query Lean during inference and revise failed proofs. AxProverBase and Numina-Lean-Agent use compact agent loops ( Requena et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) , while LongCat-Flash-Prover integrates tool use into reinforcement learning ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . OProver repairs failed proofs with compiler feedback and retrieved examples ( Ma et al., 2026 ) , and VERITAS routes verifier feedback into critic-guided search ( Acharya et al., 2026 ) . Other systems add explicit proof plans: Draft-Sketch-Prove translates informal proofs into formal sketches ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) ; Hilbert recursively decomposes goals ( Varambally et al., 2026 ) ; Seed-Prover refines proof sketches ( Chen et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025a ) ; Goedel-Architect revises a global dependency graph ( Chung et al., 2026 ) ; and LEAP combines informal blueprints, decomposition, self-refinement, and Lean feedback ( Kung et al., 2026 ) . HOA adds an independent worker–reviewer loop, reusable knowledge, and task-specific verification across formal mathematics and multidisciplinary olympiad tasks.

paragraphs.en: Olympiad and research agents increasingly combine generation with iterative verification. Aletheia uses a generator–verifier–reviser loop, browsing, and inference-time scaling ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . A model-agnostic verification-and-refinement pipeline reaches IMO gold-level performance ( Huang and Yang, 2025 ) , while domain-specific scaffolds support chemistry and broader science olympiads ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . RMA combines literature search, a shared knowledge bank, and multi-round proposer–verifier feedback for research mathematics ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . In programming, Gemini 2.5 Deep Think solved 10 of 12 problems at the 2025 ICPC World Finals, a gold-medal-level result that would have ranked second among the competing teams ( Lin and Cheng, 2025 ) . Generation, behavioral clustering, and ranking have also reached gold-level IOI 2025 performance with open-weight models ( Samadi et al., 2026 ) . HOA combines an independent worker–reviewer repair loop, a structured wiki, and task-specific verification in one workflow, then applies it across mathematics, physics, chemistry, and programming.
paragraphs.zh: 奥林匹克竞赛和研究领域的智能体越来越多地将生成与迭代验证相结合。 Aletheia 采用生成器–验证器–修订器循环、浏览以及推理时的动态扩展方法（Feng 等人，2026）。 一种模型无关的验证与优化流程达到了国际数学奥林匹克金牌水平（Huang 和 Yang，2025），而领域特定的框架则支持化学及更广泛的科学奥林匹克竞赛（Xu 等人，2025）。 RMA 将文献检索、共享知识库以及多轮提案者–验证者反馈机制结合用于研究性数学问题（Zhao 等人，2026）。 在编程领域，Gemini 2.5 Deep Think 在 2025 年 ICPC 世界决赛中解决了 12 道题中的 10 道，这一金牌级成绩若在参赛队伍中排名，将位列第二（Lin 和 Cheng，2025）。 生成、行为聚类与排序方法也借助开放权重模型达到了 2025 年 IOI 金牌水平（Samadi 等人，2026）。 HOA 将独立的执行者–评审者修复循环、结构化维基以及任务特定的验证整合到单一工作流中，并应用于数学、物理、化学和编程领域。

paragraphs.en: Formal provers increasingly use long-running agent loops. AxiomProver generated Lean proofs for all 12 Putnam 2025 problems, although its public release provides proof artifacts rather than a full system description ( Axiom, 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: HOA builds on Humanize ( Liu et al., 2026b ) , in which an independent worker and reviewer repeat until explicit acceptance criteria are met. Related methods use self-critique, stored feedback, or tool-grounded critique ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) , but self-correction can fail without a reliable external signal ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . HOA therefore separates generation, review, and verification: the reviewer provides evidence and specific revision requests, and the worker resubmits the revised artifact. For Lean tasks, Comparator builds the submission in a sandbox, matches it against the trusted statement, restricts permitted axioms, and checks the proof with the Lean kernel ( Lean FRO, 2026 ) . These checks matter because a proof can compile while using a disallowed axiom ( Vamshi and Yang, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: HOA 在 Humanize（Liu 等人，2026b）的基础上进行改进，在该方法中，独立执行者与评审员会重复操作，直到满足明确的接受标准。 相关方法使用了自我批判、已存储的反馈或基于工具的批判（Madaan 等人，2023；Shinn 等人，2023；Gou 等人，2024），但若无可靠的外部信号，自我纠正可能会失败（Huang 等人，2024）。 因此，HOA 将生成、评审和验证分离：评审员提供证据和具体的修改请求，执行者则重新提交经过修订的成果。 对于 Lean 任务，Comparator 在沙盒中构建提交内容，将其与可信陈述进行比对，限制允许使用的公理，并使用 Lean 内核检查证明（Lean FRO，2026）。 这些检查至关重要，因为一个证明可能在使用了不允许的公理的情况下仍然通过编译（Vamshi 和 Yang，2026）。

sents.en: Related methods use self-critique, stored feedback, or tool-grounded critique ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) , but self-correction can fail without a reliable external signal ( Huang et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 相关方法使用了自我批判、已存储的反馈或基于工具的批判（Madaan 等人，2023；Shinn 等人，2023；Gou 等人，2024），但若无可靠的外部信号，自我纠正可能会失败（Huang 等人，2024）。

sents.en: HOA therefore separates generation, review, and verification: the reviewer provides evidence and specific revision requests, and the worker resubmits the revised artifact.
sents.zh: 因此，HOA 将生成、评审和验证分离：评审员提供证据和具体的修改请求，执行者则重新提交经过修订的成果。

sents.en: For Lean tasks, Comparator builds the submission in a sandbox, matches it against the trusted statement, restricts permitted axioms, and checks the proof with the Lean kernel ( Lean FRO, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 对于 Lean 任务，Comparator 在沙盒中构建提交内容，将其与可信陈述进行比对，限制允许使用的公理，并使用 Lean 内核检查证明（Lean FRO，2026）。

sents.en: These checks matter because a proof can compile while using a disallowed axiom ( Vamshi and Yang, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 这些检查至关重要，因为一个证明可能在使用了不允许的公理的情况下仍然通过编译（Vamshi 和 Yang，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Agent loops also benefit from external knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation, ReAct, and RARR combine model reasoning with retrieved evidence and external actions ( Lewis et al., 2021 ; Yao et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2023 ) ; LeanDojo and ReProver retrieve premises from Lean libraries ( Yang et al., 2023 ) . HOA instead uses a bounded, task-specific wiki. Following Tau Ceti, Lean Pool, and DreamProver ( Tau Ceti Project, 2026 ; Ilin and Asher, 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , its mathematics wiki turns accepted proofs into provenance-tracked lemma records. Its chemistry wiki draws from textbooks, olympiad problems outside the evaluation set, and online references. Each run retrieves a small set of relevant records.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体循环也能从外部知识中受益。 检索增强生成（ReAct）、检索增强推理与反应（RARR）等方法将模型推理与检索到的证据及外部行动相结合（Lewis et al., 2021 ; Yao et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2023）；LeanDojo 和 ReProver 则从 Lean 库中检索前提（Yang et al., 2023）。 HOA 则使用一个有界且针对特定任务的维基。 继 Tau Ceti、Lean Pool 和 DreamProver（Tau Ceti Project, 2026 ; Ilin and Asher, 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026）之后，其数学维基将已接受的证明转化为带有来源追踪的引理记录。 其化学维基的内容来自教科书、评估集之外的奥林匹克竞赛题目以及在线参考资料。 每次运行都会检索出一小批相关记录。

paragraphs.en: HOA is a flow-level agent framework built on Humanize ( Liu et al., 2026b ) . It contains a worker , an independent reviewer , a structured wiki , and a task-specific verifier . Let x x denote the original problem and a t a_{t} the artifact produced at iteration t t . The worker constructs a t a_{t} from x x and prior feedback, consulting the wiki when it can state a specific knowledge need. The reviewer checks semantic correctness, while the verifier checks a machine-evaluable condition. For mathematics and physics tasks, HOA uses Comparator as the verifier ( Lean FRO, 2026 ) . A candidate counts as solved after every required gate accepts it.
paragraphs.zh: HOA 是一个基于 Humanize（Liu 等人，2026b）构建的流程级智能体框架。 它包含一个执行者、一个独立评审员、一个结构化维基和一个任务特定的验证器。 令 x 表示原始问题，a_{t} 表示第 t 次迭代产生的产物。 执行者根据 x 和先前的反馈构建 a_{t}，当需要明确说明特定知识需求时，会查阅维基。 评审员检查语义正确性，而验证器则检查一个机器可评估的条件。 对于数学和物理任务，HOA 使用 Comparator 作为验证器（Lean FRO，2026）。 当所有必需的关卡都接受某个候选解后，该解即被视为已解决。

sents.zh: 对于数学和物理任务，HOA 使用 Comparator 作为验证器（Lean FRO，2026）。

paragraphs.en: HOA combines three forms of feedback. Semantic feedback asks whether the artifact fully answers the original problem. Knowledge feedback supplies missing facts or methods. Objective feedback tests a machine-evaluable condition. These signals are complementary rather than interchangeable.
paragraphs.zh: HOA 结合了三种形式的反馈。 语义反馈会询问该成果是否完全回答了原始问题。 知识反馈会补充缺失的事实或方法。 客观反馈会检验一个机器可评估的条件。 这些信号是互补的，而非可以相互替换的。

paragraphs.en: The worker–reviewer loop separates artifact construction from acceptance. In each round, the worker produces or revises a candidate. An independent reviewer then evaluates the frozen candidate against the original problem and acceptance criteria. Unresolved findings return to the worker as actionable feedback for the next round. The loop ends when the reviewer declares the candidate complete or the run reaches its resource limits. This separation lets the worker explore and repair without judging its own output.
paragraphs.zh: 工作者–评审者循环将成果构建与接受环节分离。 在每一轮中，工作者会生成或修改一个候选方案。 随后，一名独立评审者会根据原始问题和接受标准，对已固化的候选方案进行评估。 未解决的问题结果将以可操作的反馈形式返回给工作者，用于下一轮的改进。 当评审者宣布候选方案已完成，或运行达到资源限制时，该循环结束。 这种分离使工作者能够在不评判自身成果的情况下进行探索与修正。

sents.zh: 工作者–评审者循环将成果构建与接受环节分离。

sents.zh: 在每一轮中，工作者会生成或修改一个候选方案。

paragraphs.en: The worker maintains the evolving artifact. In the first round, it receives the problem, task instructions, available tools, and acceptance criteria. In later rounds, it also receives the current artifact, reviewer findings, and verifier diagnostics. The worker must address every reported issue. When it identifies a knowledge gap, it sends a focused wiki query, incorporates the retrieved material with provenance, and revises the artifact. It may call the verifier for immediate machine feedback, but it cannot accept its own output or bypass review.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体负责维护不断演进的成果物。 在第一轮中，它会接收问题、任务说明、可用工具以及验收标准。 在后续轮次中，它还会接收当前的成果物、评审意见以及验证器诊断结果。 智能体必须解决所有已报告的问题。 当它发现知识缺口时，会发送一个有针对性的维基查询，将检索到的带来源信息的内容整合进来，并修订成果物。 它可以调用验证器以获取即时的机器反馈，但不能接受自己的输出结果或跳过评审流程。

paragraphs.en: The reviewer receives the original problem, candidate artifact, acceptance plan, and a runner-generated summary of the current round. It does not see the worker’s hidden reasoning or conversation history, and the candidate remains read-only during review. This separation reduces anchoring and prevents silent repairs. The reviewer instead returns findings that guide the next worker round.
paragraphs.zh: 评审者会收到原始问题、候选产物、接受计划以及由执行者生成的当前轮次的摘要。 它无法看到执行者的隐藏推理或对话历史，并且在评审期间，候选产物保持只读状态。 这种分离减少了锚定效应，并防止了静默修复。 相反，评审者会返回用于指导下一轮执行者操作的发现结果。

paragraphs.en: HOA uses separate wikis for mathematics and chemistry because the two domains require different forms of reusable knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: HOA 为数学和化学分别使用独立的维基，因为这两个领域需要不同形式的可重用知识。

paragraphs.en: The mathematics wiki follows the reusable formal libraries developed by Tau Ceti and Lean Pool ( Tau Ceti Project, 2026 ; Ilin and Asher, 2026 ) . After a mathematical problem is solved and accepted, a curation agent extracts the main theorem and reusable intermediate lemmas from the Lean development. Each record contains declaration names, Lean signatures, a short description, the source problem, required imports, source locations, and verification status.
paragraphs.zh: 该数学维基遵循了 Tau Ceti 和 Lean Pool 开发的可重用形式化库（Tau Ceti Project，2026；Ilin 和 Asher，2026）。 数学问题被解决并通过验证后，一个策展智能体会从 Lean 开发过程中提取出主定理和可重用的中间引理。 每条记录都包含声明名称、Lean 签名、简短描述、源问题、所需导入项、源位置以及验证状态。

paragraphs.en: The chemistry wiki is built before evaluation from textbooks, olympiad problems outside the test set, and relevant online references. Agents organize the material into concept-centered pages that cover definitions, reactions, formulas, experimental procedures, problem types, and solution patterns. Each page records its sources.
paragraphs.zh: 化学维基在评估前，会从教科书、测试集之外的奥林匹克竞赛题目以及相关的在线参考资料中构建内容。 智能体将这些材料组织成以概念为中心页面，涵盖定义、反应、公式、实验步骤、问题类型和解题模式。 每个页面都会记录其来源。

paragraphs.en: We do not build separate wikis for physics or coding. IPhO and IOI required knowledges are largely already presented in model pretraining. We focus the wiki on mathematics and chemistry, where structured external knowledge provides greater value.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不会为物理学或编程单独构建维基。 IPhO 和 IOI 所需的知识在很大程度上已经包含在模型预训练中了。 我们将维基的重点放在数学和化学上，因为结构化的外部知识在这些领域能带来更大的价值。

paragraphs.en: When the worker identifies a missing fact or method, it sends a focused query. The retrieval layer searches Lean declarations in the mathematics wiki or concept pages in the chemistry wiki, then returns a small set of records with source identifiers.
paragraphs.zh: 当智能体发现缺少某个事实或方法时，它会发送一个有针对性的查询。 检索层会在数学维基中搜索 Lean 声明，或在化学维基中搜索概念页面，然后返回一组带有来源标识符的记录。

sents.en: When the worker identifies a missing fact or method, it sends a focused query.
sents.zh: 当智能体发现缺少某个事实或方法时，它会发送一个有针对性的查询。

sents.zh: 检索层会在数学维基中搜索 Lean 声明，或在化学维基中搜索概念页面，然后返回一组带有来源标识符的记录。

paragraphs.en: We formalize each physics problem as a Lean theorem before asking the worker to prove it. We use the open-source Science Mango pipeline ( Humanfia, 2026 ) , which receives the problem text and figures. The pipeline first creates a blueprint that separates the physical laws, given values, results from earlier parts, and the claim to prove.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在要求智能体证明每个物理问题之前，会先将其形式化为一个 Lean 定理。 我们使用开源的 Science Mango 流程（Humanfia, 2026），该流程接收问题文本和图形。 该流程首先创建一个蓝图，将物理定律、给定值、前文结果以及待证明的论断分离开来。

sents.en: We formalize each physics problem as a Lean theorem before asking the worker to prove it.
sents.zh: 我们在要求智能体证明每个物理问题之前，会先将其形式化为一个 Lean 定理。

sents.en: We use the open-source Science Mango pipeline ( Humanfia, 2026 ) , which receives the problem text and figures.
sents.zh: 我们使用开源的 Science Mango 流程（Humanfia, 2026），该流程接收问题文本和图形。

sents.en: The pipeline first creates a blueprint that separates the physical laws, given values, results from earlier parts, and the claim to prove.
sents.zh: 该流程首先创建一个蓝图，将物理定律、给定值、前文结果以及待证明的论断分离开来。

paragraphs.en: An autoformalization agent grounds this blueprint in existing formal mathematics by querying LeanExplore ( Asher, 2025 ) , a search engine for Lean 4 declarations, over Mathlib ( mathlib Community, 2020 ) and PhysLean ( Tooby-Smith, 2024 ) . It then writes typed Lean declarations with sorry proof bodies. It preserves the roles and dimensions of physical quantities. When no library definition exists, the agent introduces a small local abstraction that retains the physical meaning. The target equation is withheld before being presented to agents for solving. If the model cannot write the physical laws as equations, it first produces a natural-language derivation and then autoformalizes that derivation. A physics reviewer compares the Lean statement with the original problem and rejects missing laws, omitted figure parameters, tautologies, and statements that assume the answer. Once the statement compiles and passes review, it is frozen. The prover may fill the proof body but cannot weaken the statement; semantic errors return for redrafting.

paragraphs.en: The verifier determines whether the current candidate satisfies a machine-evaluable acceptance condition. Its exit status and diagnostic log are retained as runner evidence. When verification fails, the calling agent receives the diagnostic summary, and the candidate cannot be accepted.
paragraphs.zh: 验证器判断当前候选项是否满足机器可评估的接受条件。 其退出状态和诊断日志会被保留为运行证据。 当验证失败时，调用智能体将收到诊断摘要，且该候选项无法被接受。

sents.en: The verifier determines whether the current candidate satisfies a machine-evaluable acceptance condition.
sents.zh: 验证器判断当前候选项是否满足机器可评估的接受条件。

sents.en: Its exit status and diagnostic log are retained as runner evidence.
sents.zh: 其退出状态和诊断日志会被保留为运行证据。

sents.zh: 当验证失败时，调用智能体将收到诊断摘要，且该候选项无法被接受。

paragraphs.en: For mathematical tasks and formalized physics task, the verifier is Comparator ( Lean FRO, 2026 ) . , which checks untrusted Lean submissions against trusted challenge statements. Comparator builds the candidate in a sandbox, confirms that the submitted theorem matches the trusted challenge, restricts permitted axioms, and validates the exported proof with the Lean kernel. Every mathematical problem is encoded as a Lean theorem and counts as solved when Comparator accepts the candidate proof. The reviewer remains responsible for detecting reward hacking and problem misunderstanding; the verifier checks whether the stated theorem is proven. For coding task, the worker and reviewer can create test cases and execute the code to see if the time limit is satisfied and if the answer is correct.
paragraphs.zh: 对于数学任务和形式化的物理任务，验证器是 Comparator (Lean FRO, 2026)，它会将不可信的 Lean 提交与可信的挑战陈述进行比对。 Comparator 在沙盒中构建候选解，确认提交的定理与可信的挑战一致，限制允许使用的公理，并通过 Lean 内核验证导出的证明。 每个数学问题都被编码为一条 Lean 定理，当 Comparator 接受候选证明时，该问题即被视为已解决。 评审员仍需负责检测奖励机制的滥用和对问题的误解；而验证器则检查所陈述的定理是否已被证明。 对于编程任务，执行者和评审员可以创建测试用例并运行代码，以检查是否满足时间限制以及答案是否正确。

paragraphs.en: The reviewer and verifier play different roles. The verifier is an objective, task-specific tool rather than an agent in the loop. Both the worker and reviewer can call it when they need machine-evaluable evidence about the current candidate.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate HOA across tasks that produce different artifacts and use different verification signals.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在生成不同产物并使用不同验证信号的各类任务中，对 HOA 进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: Our mathematics evaluation spans three levels. At the high-school olympiad level, we use Axiom Math’s formalized versions of the six IMO 2026 problems ( Axiom Math, 2026 ) with a stricter binary scoring rule. A solution receives full credit if it is mathematically correct and formalized as a Lean proof accepted by Comparator and the Lean kernel; otherwise, it receives zero points. We compare the total with the gold-medal cutoff. At the undergraduate level, we use the frozen 672-problem Lean subset of PutnamBench ( Tsoukalas et al., 2024 ) . At the research level, we use the 302 formal theorem-proving tasks in Lean-Eval. PutnamBench and Lean-Eval use the same Comparator and Lean-kernel acceptance rule.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows consistent gains across all three evaluation levels. HOA meets or exceeds the 2026 gold thresholds on IMO, IPhO, IChO, and IOI and solves 672/672 PutnamBench problems . On Lean-Eval, HOA solves 251/304 problems (82.6%) , compared with 112/304 (36.8%) for the official GPT-5.6 result—a gain of 139 proofs and 45.7 percentage points . Every formal proof is checked by the Lean kernel. Although the scoring rules differ across fields, the same pattern holds: review and revision convert failed attempts into accepted solutions.

paragraphs.en: The G 2 G_{2} tensor-square decomposition run shows how the mathematics wiki acts as an executable interface rather than an unstructured hint. During the trajectory, the agent retrieved three records that had passed Comparator and independent review. They formalize a 14-dimensional simple G 2 G_{2} quotient, a 64-dimensional irreducible highest-weight module, and the classification of fourteen irreducible tensor-square types. The agent applied these Lean declarations directly when assembling the final theorem instead of reproducing their proofs. The resulting artifact passed Comparator and both the Nanoda and default Lean kernels. This example shows how verified lemma records turn completed subproblems into typed, provenance-tracked building blocks for later formalization steps.
paragraphs.zh: G 2 G_{2} 张量平方分解的运行展示了数学维基如何作为一个可执行接口，而非一个非结构化的提示。 在轨迹过程中，该智能体检索了三个已通过 Comparator 和独立审查的记录。 他们将一个 14 维的简单 G 2 G_{2} 商、一个 64 维的不可约最高权模以及十四种不可约张量平方类型的分类形式化。 该智能体在组装最终定理时直接应用了这些 Lean 声明，而不是重新证明它们的证明过程。 最终生成的产物通过了 Comparator 以及 Nanoda 和默认 Lean 内核的验证。 这个例子展示了经过验证的引理记录如何将已完成的子问题转化为带有类型和来源追踪的构建模块，以供后续的形式化步骤使用。

paragraphs.en: Reliable long-horizon problem solving requires more than a promising initial idea. An agent must detect errors, acquire missing knowledge, preserve the original specification, and determine when the task is complete. HOA addresses these needs with a mandatory worker–reviewer repair loop, targeted wiki retrieval, and task-specific verification. Comparator checks mathematical candidates against trusted Lean statements, while programs retain their native execution tests.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠的长期问题求解不仅需要一个有前景的初步想法。 智能体必须能够检测错误、获取缺失的知识、保留原始规范，并判断任务何时完成。 HOA 通过强制性的执行者–评审员修复循环、定向维基检索以及任务特定的验证来满足这些需求。 比较器将数学候选方案与可信的 Lean 陈述进行核对，而程序则保留其原生的执行测试。

paragraphs.en: HOA reaches gold-medal-level performance on the 2026 IMO, IPhO, IChO, and IOI problems and receives full credit on PutnamBench. On research-level mathematics, it improves GPT-5.6 from 112/304 to 251/304 solved Lean-Eval tasks, ranking #1. An open-weight model with HOA also outperforms a closed-source standalone agent. These results show that workflow design is a major source of capability rather than a thin layer around the base model.
paragraphs.zh: HOA 在 2026 年国际数学奥林匹克（IMO）、国际物理奥林匹克（IPhO）、国际化学奥林匹克（IChO）和国际信息学奥林匹克（IOI）的题目上达到了金牌级表现，并在 PutnamBench 上获得了满分。 在研究级数学领域，它将 GPT-5.6 在 Lean-Eval 任务中的解题数从 112/304 提升至 251/304，位列第一。 采用 HOA 的开放权重模型也优于一个闭源的独立智能体。 这些结果表明，工作流程设计是能力的主要来源，而非仅仅是在基础模型外围添加的一层薄壳。

paragraphs.en: Future work will explore parallel workflows and divide-and-conquer strategies that split complex problems into smaller parts, solve them independently, and combine their results.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作将探索并行工作流程和分治策略，这些策略可将复杂问题拆分为更小的部分，独立解决它们，并组合其结果。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation covers a finite set of olympiad, programming, and formal-mathematics benchmarks, so it does not establish that HOA generalizes to arbitrary scientific research or to domains without reliable task-specific verification. Several reported results use closed model snapshots whose behavior, availability, and training data are not fully documented; possible benchmark contamination therefore cannot be ruled out. The comparison between workflows may also be affected by differences in inference time, token budgets, tool access, and stopping behavior. In particular, longer multi-session runs consume more computation than a single-agent baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估涵盖有限数量的奥林匹克竞赛、编程和形式化数学基准测试，因此无法证明 HOA 能够推广到任意科学研究领域或没有可靠任务特定验证机制的领域。 部分已报告的结果使用了封闭模型快照，但其行为、可用性和训练数据均未完全记录；因此，无法排除基准测试可能受到污染的情况。 工作流程之间的比较也可能受到推理时间、令牌配额、工具访问权限和停止行为差异的影响。 特别是，较长的多会话运行会比单智能体基线消耗更多的计算资源。

paragraphs.en: Comparator verifies agreement with trusted Lean statements, but this guarantee depends on the correctness and fidelity of those formalizations. It does not by itself establish that an informal problem was translated correctly. For chemistry, physics, and programming tasks, automated checks likewise cover only the properties encoded by the evaluator. Finally, the current experiments do not isolate every component interaction or fully characterize reviewer false positives and false acceptances. These constraints limit both causal attribution and the strength of claims about reliability beyond the evaluated settings.
paragraphs.zh: 比较器会验证其与可信 Lean 陈述的一致性，但这种保证取决于这些形式化表述的正确性和保真度。 它本身并不能证明非正式问题已被正确转换。 对于化学、物理和编程任务，自动化检查同样只覆盖评估器所编码的属性。 最后，当前的实验并未孤立分析所有组件间的相互作用，也未完全描述评审员的误判和错误接受情况。 这些限制不仅制约了因果归因，也削弱了关于可靠性超出已评估场景的论断力度。

paragraphs.en: An accepted artifact has no unresolved findings. When a worker disputes a finding, the evidence and final adjudication remain in the log.

paragraphs.en: The final appendix will report per-problem outcomes, confidence intervals, iteration curves, token and tool distributions, Comparator confusion analysis, wiki retrieval audits, and representative trajectories. To avoid selective reporting, the case studies will include successful repairs, false reviewer alarms, false acceptances, and runs that exhaust their budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 最终附录将报告每个问题的结果、置信区间、迭代曲线、令牌和工具分布、Comparator混淆分析、wiki检索审计以及代表性轨迹。 为避免选择性报告，案例研究将包括成功修复、审查员的误报、错误接受以及耗尽预算的运行。
